description: Capture a screenshot of the main display (the one with the menu bar), one connected display chosen by display_index, a named app window, or a pixel region. display_index is the 0-based index macos_manage_displays action=list reports for each display. Always saves a full-resolution PNG to disk, by default as a new timestamped file in MACOS_SCREENSHOT_DIR (~/Desktop when unset), and never replaces an existing file unless overwrite is true. With include_data, also returns a JPEG preview (longer side at most 1024 px) as an image content block for visual analysis and as base64 in preview. Window capture requires Screen Recording permission; all other targets do not. When the permission check cannot tell whether Screen Recording is granted, the window capture still runs and notice says why.

app_name.description: Running app for target=window, matched without regard to case against its application name ("Visual Studio Code"), localized name ("Code"), or process name ("firefox"). Captures its frontmost on-screen window, so the app must have one that is not minimized.

display_index.description: 0-based display index for target=display: the index macos_manage_displays action=list reports for each display. 0 is the main display. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

include_data.description: When true, also returns a JPEG preview, longer side at most 1024 px (a smaller capture keeps its own size), as the first content block and as base64 in preview. Defaults to false.

overwrite.description: When true, a regular .png file already at path is replaced. Without it, any existing entry at path fails with path_exists. A symbolic link, directory, or other non-file entry is never replaced, and neither is an entry created at path after the call checks it: only the file found then is replaced. No effect when path is omitted: the default path always gets a new file name. Defaults to false.

path.description: Absolute path for the output PNG, ending in .png (any case); ~/ expands to the home directory. Its directory must already exist and, with symlinks resolved, lie inside MACOS_SCREENSHOT_DIR (~/Desktop when unset), /tmp, or the home directory. Omit it, or pass an empty string, for a new screenshot-<timestamp>.png in MACOS_SCREENSHOT_DIR.

region.description: Pixel region to capture for target=region.

height.description: Region height in pixels. Must be greater than 0.

width.description: Region width in pixels. Must be greater than 0.

x.description: Left edge x-coordinate. Negative for displays left of the primary.

y.description: Top edge y-coordinate. Negative for displays above the primary.

target.description: screen — the main display only, the one with the menu bar (use display for the others); window — a named app window (requires Screen Recording); display — one connected display, chosen by display_index; region — a pixel rectangle.

name: macos_take_screenshot

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `screen_recording_required`: target=window while macOS reports Screen Recording as not granted to the MCP host app. `window_not_found`: target=window while app_name names no running app, or the app it names has no on-screen window (a minimized window is not on screen). `display_not_found`: display_index references a display not in the current configuration. `path_not_writable`: path is not absolute or resolves outside MACOS_SCREENSHOT_DIR, /tmp, and the home directory, or its directory (MACOS_SCREENSHOT_DIR when path is omitted) does not exist or cannot be written. `path_exists`: path already names a file, directory, or other entry and overwrite is not true, or overwrite is true and the entry is not a regular file, or the entry at path is not the one the call checked before capturing. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

height.description: Full-resolution image height in pixels, read from the PNG header.

notice.description: Present after a target=window capture when the Screen Recording check could not tell whether the permission is granted: names why, and what a capture without the window content means.

path.description: Absolute path of the full-resolution PNG written to disk, with symlinks in its directory resolved (a /tmp path is reported under /private/tmp).

preview.description: Base64-encoded JPEG preview, longer side at most 1024 px (a smaller capture keeps its own size), quality 70; the same image is the first content block. Present only when include_data=true.

preview_height.description: Preview image height in pixels. Present when include_data=true.

preview_width.description: Preview image width in pixels. Present when include_data=true.

width.description: Full-resolution image width in pixels, read from the PNG header.

title: Take macOS Screenshot
